issues.description: The textual part of the problem statement requires messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (a method taking a double parameter), but the UML, template usage, and reference solution define messageOnMilk() with no parameters. This mismatch will confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and prevents them from matching the provided template and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either change the problem text to require messageOnMilk() with no parameters (and show the expected return string without volume) to match the UML, template, and solution, or update the template and solution to define messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update all call sites (e.g., Main and tests) accordingly. Preferably align the textual description with the UML and template by removing the double parameter requirement.

issues.description: The problem statement describes a milk-related method with signature messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and expected return including the volume, but both the template usage and the solution define and use messageOnMilk() with no parameter. This creates a mismatch between the required API in the problem text and the actual interface/implementations, confusing students about the correct method signature to implement and call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to require messageOnMilk() without parameters and adjust the expected return text to omit volume, or (B) change the interface and all implementations/calls to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update calling sites (e.g., Main and Farm) and tests accordingly so the method accepts the milkVolume parameter and returns the string including the volume.
